value.text: Gradually worse over the month; now tired for most of the day.

value.text: Poor appetite for about a month; eating smaller meals. No nausea or vomiting.

release_text: Poor appetite for about a month; eating smaller meals. No nausea or vomiting.

value.text: No fevers or night sweats. Has lost about 4 kg over the month (from about 66 kg to 62 kg).

release_text: No fevers or night sweats. Has lost about 4 kg over the month (from about 66 kg to 62 kg).
lay_text: No fevers or sweats at night. I've lost about 4 kilos this month, I was about 66 and now I'm about 62.
rationale: Weight loss is in the article (H04) without an amount; G02 proposes a few kilograms. 4 kg matches EX.GEN.HEIGHT_WEIGHT (62 kg). Afebrile (G01, G04). The amount is the curator's choice.

value.text: Breathless on exertion, such as climbing stairs or walking quickly, for about two weeks and getting worse; not breathless at rest.

release_text: Breathless on exertion, such as climbing stairs or walking quickly, for about two weeks and getting worse; not breathless at rest.
lay_text: For the last couple of weeks I get out of breath on the stairs or if I walk fast, and it's getting worse. I'm fine sitting down.
rationale: Day-0 answer. On day 1 the article records severe breathlessness on exertion (H10), which led to transfusion; on day 0 the same symptom is milder. Hb 62 g/L, MCV 117.4 fL and reticulocytes 44.8 x10^9/L (3.07%) on day 0.

value.text: No chest pain.

lay_text: No, no chest pain.
rationale: No cardiac symptoms reported; troponin normal.

value.text: Aware of his heart pounding when he exerts himself over the last two weeks; no palpitations at rest.

release_text: Aware of his heart pounding when he exerts himself over the last two weeks; no palpitations at rest.
lay_text: When I go up the stairs I can feel my heart pounding, for the last couple of weeks. Not when I'm resting.
rationale: Hb 62 g/L with a resting pulse of 104/min; awareness of a forceful heartbeat on exertion is expected with anaemia of this depth.

value.text: No numbness, tingling or pins and needles in the hands or feet.

release_text: No numbness, tingling or pins and needles in the hands or feet.
lay_text: No, no numbness or tingling anywhere.

value.text: No easy bruising, nosebleeds, bleeding gums or other bleeding.

release_text: No easy bruising, nosebleeds, bleeding gums or other bleeding.
lay_text: No, I haven't noticed any bruises or bleeding.

value.text: Urine perhaps a little darker than usual over the last couple of weeks; never red or brown.

lay_text: Maybe a bit darker than normal for a couple of weeks. It's never been red or brown.

value.text: Has not noticed yellowing himself; a colleague said last week that his eyes looked a little yellow.

release_text: Has not noticed yellowing himself; a colleague said last week that his eyes looked a little yellow.
